en: A vintage black-and-white postcard depicting a building partially obscured by trees and vegetation. The scene shows a modest, single-story structure with a garden or landscaped area in front. The caption at the top reads, 'Cidade da Praia Hospital.' There are no people visible in the image. The overall style and print quality suggest the image is from the early 20th century.
